scope: 39 relocated algorithm files, one rewritten scalar scheduling helper, and one adapted scalar decoder. The package-internal SwiftJXLCore target now supports the public SwiftJXL scalar greyscale encoder, decoder and inspector; it is not a separately exposed library product. Public profile limits and operation admission are documented in MIGRATION.md and RESOURCE_ADMISSION.md.

All 2048 numerical context entries retained in source order. Dictionary/transform code is adapted from the predecessor; original extraction pin was not recorded. Its full dictionary blob and 5082 transformations now match independently installed libbrotli.
